phenotype: Pan-UKB icd10 J44 both_sexes EUR; EHR/ICD secondary sensitivity
beta: beta_EUR; binary logistic mixed-model log-odds coefficient
z: beta_EUR / se_EUR; never inferred from P or a meta-analysis column
p: 10**(-neglog10_pval_EUR); preserve neglog10_pval_EUR when ordinary P underflows
association_test: SAIGE score test with saddlepoint approximation for binary traits; need not equal ordinary Wald test
test_consistency_diagnostic: Compare reported neglog10 P with two-sided normal beta/SE P using independent rounding intervals. Label mismatch DIAGNOSTIC_SAIGE_VS_WALD, not allele flip, correction or automatic invalidity. Future RSS suitability remains a separate summary-LD gate.
rounding: Each printed numeric string encodes half one unit of its last printed digit, including exponent. Propagate beta and SE intervals through absolute z and log-normal survival. Reported neglog10 P interval must intersect predicted interval with absolute 1e-10 numerical slack for Wald-rounding-compatible label.
required_validity: finite beta, finite strictly positive SE, finite nonnegative neglog10 P, AF cases and controls in [0,1], nonempty distinct A/C/G/T sequence alleles, valid native position, low_confidence_EUR=false for seed eligibility
sample_size_semantics: constant phenotype-level N from release manifest; per-variant N absent; not asserted to equal all variant sample sizes or LD sample size
locus_seed: autosomal own neglog10_pval_EUR > -log10(5e-8), valid source identity and signed fields, provider low_confidence_EUR=false
locus_window: plus/minus 1500000 bp, GRCh37 chromosome clipped, transitively merge overlapping closed intervals
mhc: defer entire merged interval intersecting chr6:25000000-36000000 inclusive
tie_order: ascending ordinary source P (equivalently descending neglog10 P), chromosome, position, exact allelic key, source row
risk_direction: ALT when beta rounding interval strictly positive; REF when strictly negative; zero/rounding ambiguity/missing/invalid/low-confidence rows explicitly unresolved; palindrome retained only in documented exact build/ref/alt native contrast and never frequency-disambiguated
duplicate_policy: preserve and flag; conflicting exact identities unresolved; no rsID-only joins or silent allele fixes
deterministic_diagnostic_sample: first 100 rows per chromosome by P band (<1e-12,[1e-12,5e-8),[5e-8,0.05),>=0.05), all significant rows, and source rows divisible by 1000; whole-file vectorized diagnostics also mandatory
